info.name: Flesh and Bone
info.plot: Flesh and Bone racconta una storia di sacrificio, ambizione e talento nel mondo del balletto. La protagonista è Claire, giovane ballerina bella, piena di sentimento ed emotivamente danneggiata, che possiede, insieme ad un’innata innocenza e una forte fragilità, anche tendenze distruttive. Benché capace di raggiungere il sublime nella danza, il tormento interiore di questa giovane donna finisce col guidarla in modi imprevedibili e avvincenti. Nel primo episodio, Claire scappa da Pittsburgh e affronta le audizioni presso l’American Ballett Company di New York; dopo un’estenuante prova sarà l’unica ad essere accettata. Qui dovrà confrontarsi con le manie di protagonismo e la sfrenata ambizione del direttore artistico Paul, l’invidia di Kiira e delle altre ballerine e soprattutto dovrà fare i conti con un ospite inatteso che viene dal suo passato.

seasons.plot: Questa serie oscura e grintosa segue la giovane ballerina, Claire, mentre si unisce a una prestigiosa compagnia di danza di New York City e incontra il fascino e la disfunzione del mondo del balletto.

episodes.name: Bulling Through
episodes.plot: Claire leaves behind her troubled past and gains entry into New York City's prestigious American Ballet Company.

translations.value: Claire leaves behind her troubled past and gains entry into New York City's prestigious American Ballet Company.

episodes.name: Cannon Fodder
episodes.plot: Claire attempts to sever ties with her brother once and for all in order to embrace the city and her new life, but unwanted male attention is forced upon her at every turn.

translations.value: Claire attempts to sever ties with her brother once and for all in order to embrace the city and her new life, but unwanted male attention is forced upon her at every turn.

episodes.name: Reconnaissance
episodes.plot: In the wake of the Board Chairman's sudden departure as a result of a disastrous evening with Claire, Paul and Jessica are left scrambling to pick up the pieces.

translations.value: In the wake of the Board Chairman's sudden departure as a result of a disastrous evening with Claire, Paul and Jessica are left scrambling to pick up the pieces.

episodes.name: Boogie Dark
episodes.plot: To Bryan's dismay, Claire tries to expunge him from her New York City life. At the company Claire is challenged by the emotional vulnerability of Toni's choreography, sending her deeper into the strip club world.

translations.value: To Bryan's dismay, Claire tries to expunge him from her New York City life. At the company Claire is challenged by the emotional vulnerability of Toni's choreography, sending her deeper into the strip club world.

episodes.name: M.I.A.
episodes.plot: Claire and Kiira are pitted against each other and vie to become the face of the ABC season, while Trey attempts to remedy the rift between Paul and Ross, or so it appears.

translations.value: Claire and Kiira are pitted against each other and vie to become the face of the ABC season, while Trey attempts to remedy the rift between Paul and Ross, or so it appears.

episodes.name: F.U.B.A.R.
episodes.plot: Thanksgiving arrives, and with it Paul's neuroses, fraying the dancers' nerves. He punishes the company for their simple desire to go home for the holidays and drives them to exhaustion. Claire ventures home.

episodes.name: Full Dress
episodes.plot: With opening night of the season fast approaching, Paul faces setbacks that he blames on Toni. Paul vents his rage on Claire and wins the argument with alarming news.

episodes.name: Scorched Earth
episodes.plot: Kiira's decision throws the company into disarray on the precipice of opening night. Daphne finds herself in the spotlight. At the pre-show gala, worlds collide as Paul meets an unlikely patron, thanks to Jessica.
